name: QuickBooks Online

tiers.how: Sage connects to QuickBooks Online via the Intuit Developer API (OAuth 2.0). The owner must create an app at developer.intuit.com, complete the OAuth consent flow to obtain a refresh token, and store it in the credential store. Token refresh is automatic. Reads are free; writes (invoices, journal entries) require an approval card.
always_tap: any invoice send to a client
any journal entry or ledger edit

gotchas: OAuth refresh tokens expire if not used within 100 days; schedule a keep-alive read to prevent token expiry.
QuickBooks uses a minor-version API header that can change response shapes; pin to a known minor version in all requests.
The Intuit sandbox environment uses entirely separate credentials from the production environment.
The Intuit Developer app must be moved from development to production mode before it can access a real QuickBooks company.
notes: QuickBooks is the accounting source of truth; Sage reads financial data for cash-flow visibility and drafts invoices but never modifies the ledger without approval.
